name: Maple Living
description: Living room specialist. Discount warehouse: some of the lowest prices in town, plain finishes, no frills. We carry tv stands, sofas, rugs, armchairs, coffee tables.
skill_description: We sell tv stands, sofas, rugs, armchairs, coffee tables, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
